plan.title: Pack product and receipt then close box
plan.goal: Put the product in the box, add the receipt, then close the box.

steps.label: Place product in carton
steps.goalSource: Put the product in the box

requirements.description: Product is visible outside the carton before placement.
Product is carried across the carton opening into the interior.
decisiveDetails: hand carries product over carton opening

requirements.description: Product ends up resting inside the carton.

steps.observableEvidence: Show the product starting outside the carton, then being placed inside the open carton.

steps.label: Add receipt to carton

requirements.description: Paper sheet is visible outside the carton before placement.
Paper sheet is carried across the carton opening into the interior.
Paper sheet ends up inside the carton.

steps.observableEvidence: Show the paper sheet starting outside the carton, then being placed inside on top of the product.

steps.label: Close carton

requirements.description: Carton starts open with flaps upright.
Hands visibly fold the carton flaps closed.
decisiveDetails: hands fold side and end flaps
flaps move from open to shut

requirements.description: Carton ends fully closed with opening covered.

steps.observableEvidence: Show the open flaps being folded shut until the carton is fully closed.

limitations: Sampling is 6 fps, so brief hand motions may be missed and exact flap-fold order may be unclear.
Do not require tape sealing; user only asked to close the box and reference shows folded flaps.
